component.name: Folio AI
component.summary: Native GTK 4 & Libadwaita local AI chat and notes powered by Ollama

description.p: Folio AI is a native, modern, and persistent desktop application designed for GNOME. It combines a standard Markdown notes workspace with local LLM AI chat bubbles powered by Ollama.

ul.li: Modern Libadwaita aesthetic adhering to GNOME Human Interface Guidelines (HIG)
Non-blocking real-time streaming conversations using local Ollama models
Rich Markdown and GTK Pango formatting with code blocks, lists, and tables
Monospace text notes editor with auto-save
Strict horizontal layout constraints preventing bubble overflow
Dark and light style support following GNOME system color-scheme preferences
Persistent local JSON storage with recency-based chat sorting

description.p: Initial release of Folio AI featuring:

ul.li: Libadwaita UI with dual-mode workspace (Notes & AI Chat)
Local Ollama integration with real-time streaming
